newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 15.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Francois Guei, head of the prison service, says that an outbreak of cholera in Abidjan's MACA prison has killed 24 people and 68 are still in hospital. Unlike a 1992 outbreak, caused by insanitary conditions, the disease spread after inmates drank water meant for the gardens, he says. - Ivory Coast begin a government-sponsored week of events to inculcate a sense of civic responsibility in its citizens; President Henri Konan Bedie says the aim is to promote stability and respect for the law. LA VOIE - The governing council of Abidjan's Cocody University is to meet on Tuesday to take a decision on whether to hold end-of-year exams or declare void the academic year just ending. Campus life has been seriously disrupted by student protests. LE JOUR - A new digital telephone exchange should be in operation by December in San Pedro, Ivory Coast's second biggest port. Communications between the town and the rest of the country are frequently disrupted. (1$=605 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
